posts.title: Wards the Florist, York
posts.content: Fascia and window lettering in Margo Bold, cut from brass by a sign maker in Leeds. The florist wanted the name to read from the other side of Clifford Street.

posts.title: Village name signs, Nottinghamshire
posts.content: Replacement enamel signs for 40 villages, set in a condensed Margo drawn for the council. The distances use the tabular figures.

posts.title: Hotel menus, Folkestone
posts.content: Menus and wine lists set in Harbour Serif Regular and Semibold, letterpress printed on cotton board.

posts.title: A short run of books for a Kent press
posts.content: Six poetry titles with covers stamped in gold. Text in Harbour Serif Light at 10.5 on 14 point.

posts.title: Newsletter for a printing museum
posts.content: The Old Threshers museum newsletter, set in Margo Medium for headings and Harbour for text.

posts.title: Wood type set, for a letterpress workshop
posts.content: Margo Bold capitals cut in end-grain maple at 12 line, for a letterpress studio that runs workshops in Margate.
